# march7th api

Self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway with account-scoped API keys and integer credit accounting.

- Human documentation: /docs
- Current prices and release: /pricing
- Model availability: /models
- Current probe scope: /status
- API base: /v1
- Supported generation: POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/responses; optional POST /v1/images/generations
- Authentication: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
- Session-only receipt: /api/developer/requests/{X-Request-ID}

Missing or contradictory authoritative usage stays pending for manual reconciliation. Do not infer charges from output length.
OpenAPI auto-discovery is disabled. No embeddings or Anthropic Messages endpoint is implemented.
Never send credentials or prompt content to the public status endpoints.
